Work with a `serve` server: info, files, sort on it, status, logs, stop

```text
dspk remote [OPTIONS] --identity <IDENTITY> <ADDR> <COMMAND>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<ADDR>`**  
  Server address (IP:port)

**Options**

- **`--identity <IDENTITY>`**: env `DSPK_IDENTITY`  
  This client's identity: the file `dspk clients enroll` wrote for it
- **`--server-name <SERVER_NAME>`**: default `localhost`  
  Name the server's certificate must carry (one of its --name, or localhost)

## `dspk remote info`

Who the server is, who this client is to it, and what it is doing

```text
dspk remote --identity <IDENTITY> <ADDR> info [OPTIONS]
```

## `dspk remote files`

The files under the server's data root (directories, recordings, sortings)

```text
dspk remote --identity <IDENTITY> <ADDR> files [OPTIONS] [DIR]
```

**Arguments**

- **`[DIR]`**: default `""`  
  A directory under the data root (default: the root)

## `dspk remote sort`

Sort a recording on the server (control permission)

```text
dspk remote --identity <IDENTITY> <ADDR> sort [OPTIONS] <RECORDING>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<RECORDING>`**  
  The recording, under the server's data root

**Options**

- **`--sorter <SORTER>`**: default `kilosort4`  
  kilosort4, emusort, mountainsort5, spykingcircus2, tridesclous2
- **`--output <OUTPUT>`**: default `""`  
  Where the sorting goes, under the data root (default: next to the recording, &lt;name>.&lt;sorter>.sorting.zarr)
- **`--probe <PROBE>`**: default `""`  
  A probe preset (default: the recording's own geometry)
- **`--source <SOURCE>`**: default `""`  
  The source within the recording's file (default: its default one)
- **`--start-sec <START_SEC>`**: default `0`  
  Start of the part to sort (s)
- **`--duration-sec <DURATION_SEC>`**: default `0`  
  Length of the part to sort (s; 0 = to the end)
- **`--param <PARAMS>`**  
  A sorter parameter away from its default, as name=value (repeat; names as in `dspk sort <sorter> --help`, without "--")
- **`--wait`**  
  Follow the sort to its end

## `dspk remote status`

The server's state and its job's progress

```text
dspk remote --identity <IDENTITY> <ADDR> status [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- **`--follow`**  
  Keep showing it until the job ends

## `dspk remote logs`

The job's last log lines

```text
dspk remote --identity <IDENTITY> <ADDR> logs [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- **`-n, --lines <LINES>`**: default `50`

## `dspk remote stop`

Stop the running job (control permission)

```text
dspk remote --identity <IDENTITY> <ADDR> stop [OPTIONS]
```

## `dspk remote fetch`

Fetch a file, or a directory such as a .sorting.zarr, into a new local path

```text
dspk remote --identity <IDENTITY> <ADDR> fetch [OPTIONS] <PATH> [DEST]
```

**Arguments**

- **`<PATH>`**  
  Under the server's data root
- **`[DEST]`**  
  Where to put it (default: its name, here); never overwritten
